profile.summary: The Cynefin Company is the organisational home for current development, teaching and application of Cynefin, SenseMaker and associated naturalising sense-making methods.
profile.why_it_matters: Organisations carry methods through products, training, communities, archives and revision. The organisational source is canonical for current self-description but cannot stand as independent evidence of its own impact.
